task_completion.description: Open the initial rocket design file 'drag_heavy_rocket.ork' in OpenRocket.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The OpenRocket window title or file menu showing 'drag_heavy_rocket.ork' is open.

task_completion.description: Change all external surface finishes (Nose cone, Body tube, etc.) to 'Polished'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Component configuration dialogs showing the 'Finish' dropdown set to 'Polished'.
The Fin Set configuration dialog showing the 'Cross section' dropdown set to 'Airfoil'.

task_completion.description: Remove the launch lug component from the rocket design.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The component tree in the main OpenRocket window no longer lists a 'Launch lug'.
The 'Save As' dialog or the window title showing the new file path 'optimized_rocket.ork'.

task_completion.description: Run flight simulations to determine the baseline and optimized apogee values.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Flight simulations' tab in OpenRocket showing simulation results with apogee values.

task_completion.description: Create a report at '/home/ga/Documents/exports/aerodynamic_report.txt' containing baseline apogee, optimized apogee, net gain, and summary.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing the content of 'aerodynamic_report.txt' with the required numerical data and summary.

integrity.description: The agent used the OpenRocket GUI to perform modifications rather than just editing the XML file directly via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent clicking through OpenRocket component menus and dialog boxes.

integrity.description: The agent did not change the motor from the required G80 to a more powerful one to fake altitude gain.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Motors & Configuration' tab or simulation settings showing the motor is still a 'G80'.

integrity.description: The apogee values in the report match the values shown in the OpenRocket simulation UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: Comparison between the text in the final report and the 'Apogee' column in the OpenRocket simulation table.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The starting file is 'drag_heavy_rocket.ork'. The required motor is 'G80' and must not be changed. The target surface finish is 'Polished' and fin cross-section is 'Airfoil'. The launch lug must be deleted. The final report must be at '/home/ga/Documents/exports/aerodynamic_report.txt' and the new model at '/home/ga/Documents/rockets/optimized_rocket.ork'. The optimized apogee should be higher than the baseline due to reduced drag.
